Subject: Site kit consolidation: proposal + attachments

Hi team — proposed consolidation plan below. See attached stubs: packing_list_sitekit.xlsx and boxed_dimensions.pdf.

Summary plan (option A — preferred):
- Combine printed materials and swag into two large crates (tied to pallets).
- Laptops and demo rack components secured in a padded wooden crate (shock rated).
- Total: 2 pallets (pallet A: demo hardware crate, pallet B: swag + printed playbooks).
- Gross weight: 1,120 lbs total; footprint: 48\"x40\" pallet x2; heights 42\" and 36\" respectively.

Courier options (door-to-dock):
- QuickShip Priority (2-day): $1,120 + fuel surcharge; earliest pickup Feb 24, ETA Feb 25 EOD to San Francisco Dock 4.
- FreightLine Standard (3–4 day): $720; pickup Feb 24, ETA Feb 26 midday.

Customs & paperwork:
- We will pre-fill commercial invoice and packing list; ask NovaMed to confirm NVO/ILO contact for customs release.
- Suggested Incoterm: DAP (Delivered at Place) – Redwood covers transit until delivery at Dock 4.

On-site acceptance and staging:
- Rebecca Yang will sign for the delivery and redirect to the 3rd-floor conference center staging area. We recommend a 2-hour window where NovaMed operations can inspect crates before we set up demo racks.

Attachments: packing_list_sitekit.xlsx (inventory + weights), boxed_dimensions.pdf (per-item dims).

If we go with QuickShip Priority I can loop Felix (their logistics rep) for rate confirmation and pickup booking.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
